chunks: 'Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Sa'd, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Musa, from Zurarah, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
If it is miscarried at six months, then it is complete; and that is because al-Husayn ibn 'Ali عليه السلام was born while he was the son of six months.

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ السَّل: Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام, cited here as the precedent
key_terms.تَامٌّ: complete; deemed fully formed in legal context

ai.seo_question: Is a child born at six months considered complete in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a fetus delivered at six months is considered complete. It supports this ruling by citing the birth of al-Husayn ibn 'Ali عليه السلام at six months as a precedent.
